topics.label: Course introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: It provides the introductory framing, course overview, and expected learning outcomes for the lecture series.

topics.label: Biological foundations of cancer and in vitro models
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the molecular and architectural basis of cancer as a failure of normal cellular differentiation and examine the models used to study these cellular behaviors.

topics.label: Pathology and progression of tumor invasion and metastasis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe the mechanisms, histological identification, and progression of tumors from localized benign lesions to invasive and metastatic malignancies.

topics.label: Tumor nomenclature and clinical mechanisms of disease
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore the naming conventions for different neoplasms and the pathophysiological mechanisms by which tumors cause illness and death.

topics.label: Cancer incidence across humans and multicellular species
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine patterns of cancer frequency across human populations and compare tumor occurrence across different multicellular animal taxa.

topics.label: Clinical cancer detection and screening methods
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics address the rationale, histological basis, and diagnostic modalities used to screen for and detect pre-malignant and malignant lesions.

topics.label: Lecture closing and housekeeping
topics.groupedBecause: It provides the concluding remarks, reminders regarding learning outcomes, and upcoming schedule information.
